champion.tips: BRAUM TIPS AND TRICKS Braum doesn’t need to play aggressive 24/7. Wait for the enemy to engage and then turn the exchange around. Always stick with your team, in particular, the ADC so you can protect and peel them with your E . Don’t use your E to block damage in small trades. It’s best to save it for extended or long trades only so you do not run out of mana. Also, keeping your E off cooldown will help you if the enemy decides to commit to a full trade.
champion.builds: THE BEST BRAUM BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Braum Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Guardian as your keystone, followed by Font of Life, Bone Plating and Unflinching in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Solstice Sleigh as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Locket of the Iron Solari. For your last 3 items, you should build Redemption, Knight's Vow and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 52.2% winrate over 13 812 matches played. Optional Your second option for Braum Support build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Guardian as your keystone, Font of Life, Bone Plating and Unflinching in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Celestial Opposition, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Locket of the Iron Solari as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Redemption, Knight's Vow and Vigilant Wardstone. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 48.4% win rate over 13 213 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Unsealed Spellbook as your keystone, Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Unflinching in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Move Speed, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Redemption as a third item. You want to finish the build with Locket of the Iron Solari, Knight's Vow and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 47.6% win rate across 2 680 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Braum Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Aftershock, Font of Life, Bone Plating and Unflinching as your primary rune tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Health Scaling and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Celestial Opposition as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Locket of the Iron Solari as third item. The last 3 options are Redemption, Knight's Vow and Kaenic Rookern. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 45.2% win rate over 932 matches played. Situational Braum Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Braum build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Braum runes page.
